cases.sentence: ___ посмотрел на членов высшего совета и сказал.
cases.translation: Paul looked at the members of the high council and spoke.
cases.explain: Павел is the grammatical subject of посмотрел (looked), requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: The high priest ordered to strike Paul.
cases.explain: Павла is the direct object of ударить (strike), requiring accusative case.

cases.translation: Paul spoke to the high priest standing before the council.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Мы не находим в этом человеке ничего плохого, говорили учители ___.
cases.translation: We find no evil in this man, the teachers of the law said.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used to show possession or affiliation—'teachers of the law.'

cases.translation: Paul spoke loudly to the members of the high council.
cases.explain: Говорил (said to) takes the dative case for the recipient.

cases.translation: The Roman commander, fearing for Paul.
cases.explain: The preposition за (for) with accusative expresses concern for someone.

cases.sentence: Некоторые иудеи собрались и поклялись ничего не есть до тех пор, пока не убьют ___.
cases.translation: Some Jews gathered and swore an oath to eat nothing until they killed Paul.
cases.explain: Убить (to kill) is a transitive verb requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Спор разгорелся перед ___, который опасался за жизнь Павла.
cases.translation: The argument escalated before the commander, who feared for Paul's life.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Павел посмотрел на членов высшего совета и сказал, «Братья, вплоть до сегодняшнего дня я жил с чистой совестью перед Богом».
reading.question: What did Paul claim about how he had lived until that day?
options: He lived with a clear conscience before God
He lived in great fear and anxiety
He lived in ignorance of the law
reading.correct: He lived with a clear conscience before God
reading.explain: Павел сказал о том, что он жил с чистой совестью перед Богом — Paul declared he had lived with a clear conscience before God.

reading.ru: Первосвященник Анания приказал стоявшим рядом с Павлом ударить его по губам.
reading.question: What did the high priest Ananias command the men standing near Paul to do?
reading.explain: Анания приказал ударить его по губам — Ananias commanded them to strike him on the mouth.

reading.ru: Павел знал, что одни из них были саддукеями, а другие — фарисеями, поэтому он громко сказал членам высшего совета.
reading.question: Why did Paul speak aloud to the council?
options: Because he recognized there were both Sadducees and Pharisees present
Because he was angry at the high priest
Because the soldiers forced him to speak
reading.correct: Because he recognized there were both Sadducees and Pharisees present
reading.explain: Павел знал, что одни были саддукеями, а другие — фарисеями — Paul knew some were Sadducees and others were Pharisees, which prompted him to speak.

reading.ru: Когда он это сказал, между фарисеями и саддукеями разгорелся спор, и собрание разделилось.
reading.question: What was the result of Paul's statement to the council?
options: An argument broke out between Pharisees and Sadducees and the assembly was divided
reading.correct: An argument broke out between Pharisees and Sadducees and the assembly was divided
reading.explain: между фарисеями и саддукеями разгорелся спор, и собрание разделилось — an argument arose between them and the assembly divided.

reading.ru: Командир римского полка, опасаясь, как бы Павла не разорвали на части, приказал солдатам забрать его от них силой и увезти в казарму.
reading.question: What did the Roman commander order the soldiers to do?
options: Take Paul by force and bring him to the barracks
Allow the Jews to take Paul
Release Paul to the high priest
reading.correct: Take Paul by force and bring him to the barracks
reading.explain: Командир приказал солдатам забрать его от них силой и увезти в казарму — The commander ordered soldiers to take him by force and bring him to the barracks.

reading.ru: Наутро некоторые иудеи собрались и поклялись ничего не есть и не пить до тех пор, пока не убьют Павла.
reading.question: What oath did some of the Jews take?
options: To eat and drink nothing until they killed Paul
To never speak to Paul again
reading.correct: To eat and drink nothing until they killed Paul
reading.explain: Иудеи поклялись ничего не есть и не пить до тех пор, пока не убьют Павла — The Jews swore an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.
